title: Ways to fight tiredness
paragraphs: Everyone gets tired – it's a normal part of human existence. It can make us grouchy and grumpy at the end of the day, but a good night's sleep will often leave us feeling well rested. However, sometimes we feel more than just general tiredness. We can get overtired and feel a bit run-down which may affect our daily lives – but what can we do about it? Here are some things that may stop you getting overtired.

Being very tired frequently could be the result of lifestyle choices: poor diet, lack of exercise, or an inefficient routine. For some people, changes to their habits and routines could help them to beat bouts of extreme tiredness. First, let's look at physical health. According to the UK National Health Service (NHS) website, eating healthy meals and snacks regularly, around 3-4 times per day, could improve your energy levels. Giving your body the fuel it needs could help you to be more energised, and therefore, less tired. If you're feeling overtired, you might not want to exercise. However, regular physical activity may actually mean you are less tired in general. Activities like jogging or cycling could also help you get fitter. And being more active could help you to lose weight, which can also aid you in the battle against tiredness. Those extra kilos from being overweight put a strain on your heart, which can lead to you feeling more tired.

Another thing that can leave us feeling weary and drained is stress. Reducing your stress levels may help you to feel less tired on a regular basis. Taking up an activity like yoga or going for a walk could help you to unwind and feel more refreshed. And you may think if you're feeling tired, that a good cup of coffee will perk you up. However, the Royal College of Psychiatrists recommends anyone feeling tired to cut down on their caffeine intake, especially after mid-afternoon, to get better sleep at night.

Finally, if you do find yourself feeling overtired constantly for days or weeks, you may be suffering from fatigue or exhaustion. If so, it could be a good idea to visit the doctor in case it's a symptom of an underlying health issue. However, for most of us, the odd day of feeling overtired might be fixed with a change in lifestyle and a few good nights' sleep.

vocabulary.entry: existence /ɪɡˈzɪstəns/ n. 存在；生存【书面词汇】
vocabulary.example: The hotel has been in existence for 150 years.
vocabulary.translation: 这家酒店已经存在150年了。

vocabulary.entry: grouchy /ˈɡraʊtʃi/ adj. 脾气不好的；易怒的【口语词汇】
vocabulary.example: She's just tired and feeling a bit grouchy.
vocabulary.translation: 她只是累了，有点脾气不好。

vocabulary.entry: grumpy /ˈɡrʌmpi/ adj. 脾气暴躁的；闷闷不乐的【口语词汇】
vocabulary.example: My dad gets grumpy when he's hungry.
vocabulary.translation: 我爸爸饿的时候就会脾气暴躁。

vocabulary.entry: overtired /ˌəʊvəˈtaɪəd/ adj. 过度疲劳的
vocabulary.example: The overtired children fell asleep immediately.
vocabulary.translation: 过度疲劳的孩子们立刻睡着了。

vocabulary.entry: run-down /ˌrʌn ˈdaʊn/ adj. 精神萎靡的；疲惫不堪的【口语词汇】
vocabulary.example: I'm feeling a bit run-down after all that travelling.
vocabulary.translation: 旅行之后我感觉有点疲惫不堪。

vocabulary.entry: inefficient /ˌɪnɪˈfɪʃnt/ adj. 效率低的；无效率的【书面词汇】
vocabulary.example: The company's inefficient systems cost a lot of money.
vocabulary.translation: 公司效率低下的系统耗费了大量资金。

vocabulary.entry: routine /ruːˈtiːn/ n. 常规；惯例；作息
vocabulary.example: I need a routine to help me organize my day.
vocabulary.translation: 我需要一套作息来帮我安排一天的生活。

vocabulary.entry: bout /baʊt/ n. 一阵；一次（不愉快的事）【书面词汇】
vocabulary.example: She had a bout of flu last winter.
vocabulary.translation: 她去年冬天得了一场流感。

vocabulary.entry: energised /ˈenədʒaɪzd/ adj. 精力充沛的
vocabulary.example: I feel energised after a good night's sleep.
vocabulary.translation: 睡了一夜好觉后我感觉精力充沛。

vocabulary.entry: jogging /ˈdʒɒɡɪŋ/ n. 慢跑
vocabulary.example: I go jogging every morning before work.
vocabulary.translation: 我每天上班前都去慢跑。

vocabulary.entry: cycling /ˈsaɪklɪŋ/ n. 骑行；骑自行车运动
vocabulary.example: Cycling is a good way to keep fit.
vocabulary.translation: 骑行是保持健康的好方法。

vocabulary.entry: overweight /ˌəʊvəˈweɪt/ adj. 超重的；过重的
vocabulary.example: He was ten kilos overweight.
vocabulary.translation: 他超重了十公斤。

vocabulary.entry: strain /streɪn/ n. 负担；压力【书面词汇】
vocabulary.example: The sudden flood put a terrible strain on local resources.
vocabulary.translation: 突如其来的洪水给当地资源带来了巨大负担。

vocabulary.entry: weary /ˈwɪəri/ adj. 疲倦的；疲惫的【书面词汇】
vocabulary.example: I felt weary after a long day at work.
vocabulary.translation: 工作了一整天后我感到疲惫不堪。

vocabulary.entry: drained /dreɪnd/ adj. 精疲力竭的；耗尽精力的
vocabulary.example: I'm completely drained after the meeting.
vocabulary.translation: 会议结束后我彻底精疲力竭了。

vocabulary.entry: unwind /ʌnˈwaɪnd/ v. 放松；松弛【口语词汇】
vocabulary.example: I like to unwind with a glass of wine in the evening.
vocabulary.translation: 我喜欢晚上喝杯酒放松一下。

vocabulary.entry: refreshed /rɪˈfreʃt/ adj. 恢复精力的；神清气爽的
vocabulary.example: I feel refreshed after my holiday.
vocabulary.translation: 度假后我感觉精力恢复了。

vocabulary.entry: perk up /pɜːk ʌp/ 短语 振作起来；精神振奋【口语词汇】
vocabulary.example: A cup of tea might perk you up.
vocabulary.translation: 喝杯茶或许能让你振作起来。

vocabulary.entry: psychiatrist /saɪˈkaɪətrɪst/ n. 精神科医生；精神病学家【书面词汇】
vocabulary.example: The psychiatrist helped her deal with her anxiety.
vocabulary.translation: 精神科医生帮她应对焦虑情绪。

vocabulary.entry: recommend /ˌrekəˈmend/ v. 建议；推荐【书面词汇】
vocabulary.example: I recommend buying the larger size.
vocabulary.translation: 我建议买大一号的。

vocabulary.entry: caffeine /ˈkæfiːn/ n. 咖啡因
vocabulary.example: Coffee and tea contain caffeine.
vocabulary.translation: 咖啡和茶都含有咖啡因。

vocabulary.entry: intake /ˈɪnteɪk/ n. 摄入；摄入量【书面词汇】
vocabulary.example: Reduce your salt intake for better health.
vocabulary.translation: 为了健康减少盐的摄入量。

vocabulary.entry: constantly /ˈkɒnstəntli/ adv. 持续地；不断地
vocabulary.example: He's constantly changing his mind.
vocabulary.translation: 他总是不断改变主意。

vocabulary.entry: fatigue /fəˈtiːɡ/ n. 疲劳；疲乏【书面词汇】
vocabulary.example: She was suffering from fatigue after the long journey.
vocabulary.translation: 长途旅行后她感到疲惫不堪。

vocabulary.entry: exhaustion /ɪɡˈzɔːstʃən/ n. 精疲力竭；疲惫【书面词汇】
vocabulary.example: He collapsed with exhaustion after the race.
vocabulary.translation: 比赛结束后他累得瘫倒在地。

vocabulary.entry: symptom /ˈsɪmptəm/ n. 症状【书面词汇】
vocabulary.example: Fever is a symptom of many illnesses.
vocabulary.translation: 发烧是许多疾病的症状。

vocabulary.entry: underlying /ˌʌndəˈlaɪɪŋ/ adj. 潜在的；根本的【书面词汇】
vocabulary.example: The underlying cause of the problem is still unknown.
vocabulary.translation: 这个问题的根本原因尚不清楚。

sentences.english: Everyone gets tired – it's a normal part of human existence.
sentences.chinese: 每个人都会感到疲惫——这是人类生存的正常状态。

sentences.english: It can make us grouchy and grumpy at the end of the day, but a good night's sleep will often leave us feeling well rested.
sentences.chinese: 一天结束时，疲惫会让我们脾气暴躁、心情烦躁，但一夜好眠通常会让我们感觉精力恢复。

sentences.english: However, sometimes we feel more than just general tiredness.
sentences.chinese: 然而，有时我们感受到的不只是普通的疲惫。

sentences.english: We can get overtired and feel a bit run-down which may affect our daily lives – but what can we do about it?
sentences.chinese: 我们会过度劳累、精神萎靡，这可能会影响日常生活——但我们该如何应对呢？

sentences.english: Here are some things that may stop you getting overtired.
sentences.chinese: 以下是一些能帮你避免过度疲惫的方法。

sentences.english: Being very tired frequently could be the result of lifestyle choices: poor diet, lack of exercise, or an inefficient routine.
sentences.chinese: 频繁感到极度疲惫可能是生活方式选择导致的：饮食不佳、缺乏锻炼，或是作息效率低下。

sentences.english: For some people, changes to their habits and routines could help them to beat bouts of extreme tiredness.
sentences.chinese: 对一些人来说，改变习惯和作息有助于摆脱一阵阵的极度疲惫。

sentences.english: First, let's look at physical health.
sentences.chinese: 首先，我们来看看身体健康。

sentences.english: According to the UK National Health Service (NHS) website, eating healthy meals and snacks regularly, around 3-4 times per day, could improve your energy levels.
sentences.chinese: 英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）官网指出，规律进食健康的正餐和快餐，每天约3至4次，能够提升你的精力水平。

sentences.english: Giving your body the fuel it needs could help you to be more energised, and therefore, less tired.
sentences.chinese: 为身体提供所需的能量能让你更有活力，进而减少疲惫感。

sentences.english: If you're feeling overtired, you might not want to exercise.
sentences.chinese: 如果你感到过度劳累，或许不想运动。

sentences.english: However, regular physical activity may actually mean you are less tired in general.
sentences.chinese: 然而，规律的体育锻炼实际上通常可能会让你不那么疲惫。

sentences.english: Activities like jogging or cycling could also help you get fitter.
sentences.chinese: 慢跑、骑行等运动还能让你更健康。

sentences.english: And being more active could help you to lose weight, which can also aid you in the battle against tiredness.
sentences.chinese: 增加活动量有助于减重，这也能帮你对抗疲惫。

sentences.english: Those extra kilos from being overweight put a strain on your heart, which can lead to you feeling more tired.
sentences.chinese: 超重带来的多余体重会给心脏造成负担，进而让你更易感到疲惫。

sentences.english: Another thing that can leave us feeling weary and drained is stress.
sentences.chinese: 另一个让我们感到疲惫不堪、精力耗尽的因素是压力。

sentences.english: Reducing your stress levels may help you to feel less tired on a regular basis.
sentences.chinese: 降低压力水平有助于你减少日常的疲惫感。

sentences.english: Taking up an activity like yoga or going for a walk could help you to unwind and feel more refreshed.
sentences.chinese: 开始做瑜伽、散步等活动能帮你放松身心、恢复精力。

sentences.english: And you may think if you're feeling tired, that a good cup of coffee will perk you up.
sentences.chinese: 你或许觉得疲惫时喝一大杯咖啡就能提神。

sentences.english: However, the Royal College of Psychiatrists recommends anyone feeling tired to cut down on their caffeine intake, especially after mid-afternoon, to get better sleep at night.
sentences.chinese: 然而，英国皇家精神科医学院建议感到疲惫的人减少咖啡因摄入，尤其是下午三点之后，这样能让夜间睡眠质量更好。

sentences.english: Finally, if you do find yourself feeling overtired constantly for days or weeks, you may be suffering from fatigue or exhaustion.
sentences.chinese: 最后，如果你连续数天、数周都持续感到过度疲惫，你可能正饱受疲劳或精疲力竭的困扰。

sentences.english: If so, it could be a good idea to visit the doctor in case it's a symptom of an underlying health issue.
sentences.chinese: 如果是这样，最好去看医生，以防这是潜在健康问题的症状。

sentences.english: However, for most of us, the odd day of feeling overtired might be fixed with a change in lifestyle and a few good nights' sleep.
sentences.chinese: 不过，对我们大多数人来说，偶尔一天的过度疲惫，通过改变生活方式和几晚优质睡眠就能得到缓解。
